The '''Perithal system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Perithal VI]].
